newsitem.title: USA: Republican hopeful of budget agreement.
newsitem.headline: Republican hopeful of budget agreement.

text.p: Republican Sen. Connie Mack, responding to President Clinton's call to work for a balanced budget, said he was hopeful an agreement could be reached with the administration.

"I'm certainly hopeful we can do that. It's important that the president indicate what his blueprint is. It's possible we'll get a feel for that at our meeting Tuesday," Mack, of Florida, said at a news conference. He is chairman of the Joint Economic Committee.
President Clinton has asked congressional leaders of both parties to meet with him next Tuesday.
